verdict.rationale: A machine-readable spec is a fair question for a government filing service that offers a sanctioned third-party software channel (ERiC), so the axis applies. However, no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The docs only say that ELSTER-compatible tax software can transmit, and the probe reports that the ERiC developer-artifact host (esteuer.de) timed out for a keyless client. An earlier fetch of taxonomy bundles from that host does not show a machine-readable API spec.
